name: Bloodletter
author: vkays
description: Adds a unique scimitar, Bloodletter, found in Lucia's chest during the Test Pocket quest. On a successful hit, has a 30% chance to inflict a bleeding wound (2-4 Slashing damage every 5 seconds for 15 seconds). Ships a crimson recolor_icon_in_place recolor of the vanilla Scimitar icon -- a from-scratch custom render was attempted first and surfaced real new findings about the mdl16 format (see docs/mdl16-icon-format.md) but never rendered correctly in-game, so the art fell back to the proven-safe recolor technique.
